desc: Implement DSU with path compression, union by size, and component counting.
Build a mapping from present values at most `threshold` to their input indices; values above the threshold remain isolated.
Sweep multiples of each present value, storing one representative index per multiple and unioning subsequent representatives.
Verify that common-multiple unions are equivalent to edges with LCM at most `threshold`.
Ensure complexity is approximately `O(threshold log threshold + n)` time and `O(threshold + n)` space.
